Today Apple TV released the trailer for "Nocturne," a brand-new thriller adapted from Lars Kepler's bestselling crime novel "The Sandman."

"Nocturne" is a brand-new thriller set to premiere on October 30

Apple TV's library is packed with fantastic crime thrillers, and even more are expected to be added this fall.

One of them — "Nocturne" — is adapted from Lars Kepler's bestselling novel "The Sandman."

"Nocturne" will debut on Friday, October 30, with the first two episodes available immediately, followed by one episode per week through December 25.

The series centers on a serial killer and stars Liev Schreiber and Zazie Beetz, with Stephen Graham ("Adolescence") playing the killer.

Apple just dropped the trailer, giving us our first look at this terrifying new series. Below is the official synopsis for "Nocturne," followed by the trailer.

Two weeks before "Nocturne" premieres, another crime thriller, "12 12 12," will land on Apple TV. That series stars Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan and follows a heist, spanning 12 months of planning, a 12-hour operation, and the 12 days that follow.

Looking beyond the fall, Apple plans to kick off 2027 with the highly anticipated thriller "The Wanted Man," starring Hugh Laurie as the head of an organized crime ring.

Will you be watching "Nocturne" when it premieres next month? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month and can also be subscribed to through the Apple One bundle deal.
